title: Unfold
summary: A's items leave, A folds into a glowing line, B unfolds out of the line with overshoot, items rise from it.

params.name: duration
params.description: length of the transition in seconds; springs use it to keep their feel

notes: A's items leave, A folds into a glowing line, a glint runs along it, and B unfolds out of the line with overshoot as its items rise from it.
Stack A and B in one positioned slot (their parent); give the slot overflow:hidden to keep travel inside it.
Pass the real duration in seconds and call it through p = 1: that is when it hides the layers it made.
